values.note: $29 a night for an RV: the $22 water/electric campsite fee plus Florida's $7 nightly utility fee for RVs (the 26 primitive tent-only sites are $12), plus tax and a $6.70 reservation fee per reservation. No out-of-state rate; Florida residents 65 and over get half off the campsite fee.

values.note: 64 sites: 38 with power and water (Reserve Florida lists 39) and 26 primitive tent sites. Booking-site limits for the hookup sites run 22-40 ft, most 40; eight are pull-through.

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/rodman-campground/experiences-amenities ('A 64-site campground offers 26 primitive tent sites and 38 sites with power and water hookups') + Reserve Florida search/grid and search/details for facility 154 (VehicleLength, PullInTypeName), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Two-lane boat ramp and picnic pavilions in the campground.
